versions.changelog:
**Major update: adds full multi-format build scripts, templates, prompts, and site skeletons for Cookbook-forge automation.**

- Added assets and scripts to support automated conversion from MDX to ElegantBook LaTeX/PDF, Nextra site, and optimized EPUB using both LLM and pure JS pipelines.
- Included full Nextra v3 website skeleton with Dockerfile, config, scripts, and pages for instant deployment.
- Provided LLM prompt templates for MDX→LaTeX and MDX→EPUB conversion, and utility scripts for diagram rendering, formula/image fixes, word count, and font subsetting.
- Added comprehensive style guide references and single-chapter MDX templates for consistent output.
- Updated workflows and documentation to reflect new modular, template-driven, and LLM-enabled architecture.
- Removed deprecated skill-card; all documentation is now in SKILL.md and references.

Cookbook Forge 1.0.0: initial release — generates deep technical CookBooks, Handbooks, and Surveys from multi-source materials, outputting to MDX, ElegantBook PDF, Nextra site, and optimized EPUB.

- Converts user materials (websites, PDFs, EPUBs, GitHub, arxiv, docs) into chaptered MDX, then to LaTeX/PDF, website, or EPUB.
- Follows O'Reilly CookBook and Springer Handbook styles; rich support for technical diagrams and code.
- Flexible output: MDX (default), ElegantBook LaTeX/PDF, Nextra v3 website, and EPUB, each in their own subdirectory.
- Automated, exhaustive collection of resources, including browser and CLI skills/tooling for web, code, and document parsing.
- Comprehensive workflow: input parsing, resource gathering, outline design with user confirmation, chaptered MDX writing, and multi-format export.
- Includes scripts/assets for font subsetting, formula image optimization, PDF/EPUB/website build pipelines, and standardized templates.
